Active noise cancellation works by capturing the ambient wave and inverting it before it reaches the ear.
The inverted wave overlaps the original wave, which means the two cancel at the listener's ear.
ANC headphones use small microphones that sample outside noise continuously.
The cancellation is less effective for high frequencies probably because timing shifts grow.
